map.纺织品色牢度等级标准与灰卡对照查询: Textile color fastness grade standard and gray scale comparison query
map.色牢度按 GB/T 3921 评级：变色用灰色样卡（GB/T 250）、沾色用灰: Color fastness is graded by GB/T 3921: color change with gray scale (GB/T 250), staining with gray scale (GB/T 251), rated 1 to 5, 5 best and 1 worst, half-grade as finest step; wash fastness ≥4 is excellent, 3 is pass, below 3 fails; test conditions include temperature (40-95 ℃), time and soap concentration, varying by fiber and shade (dark shades may be relaxed by half grade).
map.考核织物经洗涤后的变色和沾色程度。: Assesses color change and staining after washing.
map.分干摩擦和湿摩擦，考核颜色迁移。: Dry and wet rubbing; assesses color migration.
map.考核颜色在光照下褪色程度，使用蓝色羊毛标样对照。: Assesses fading under light using blue wool standards.
map.分酸性和碱性汗液，考核接触汗液后的变色沾色。: Acidic and alkaline perspiration; assesses change/staining after sweat contact.
map.婴幼儿纺织品强制要求，考核接触唾液后的色牢度。: Mandatory for infant textiles; assesses fastness after saliva contact.
map.色牢度分为变色牢度（原样变色）和沾色牢度（白布沾色）两项分别评级。耐光色牢度使用: Fastness has two separately rated items: color change (original) and staining (white cloth). Light fastness uses 1-8 (8 best).
map.出厂检验：按 GB/T 标准查耐水洗/摩擦/汗渍/唾液等牢度等级与评价。: Factory inspection: check wash/rub/perspiration/saliva fastness grades per GB/T.
map.客诉判定：比对变色灰卡等级与 ΔE 范围，定位是否达标（3 级为合格品下限）。: Complaint adjudication: compare gray-scale grade and ΔE range to determine pass (grade 3 is the qualified floor).
map.选耐水洗色牢度（GB/T 3921）、评定 4 级 → 变色轻微、ΔE 1.0–: Select wash fastness (GB/T 3921), grade 4 → slight change, ΔE 1.0-2.0, 'first-class pass'; if only grade 3 it is qualified pass, below grade 2 fails and needs process/finishing improvement.
map.变色牢度和沾色牢度为什么要分开评？: Why rate color change and staining separately?
map.两者机理不同：变色看原样褪色、沾色看白布被染；同一样品两项可能一高一低，需分别评: Different mechanisms: change sees original fading, staining sees white cloth dyed; one sample may score high on one and low on the other, rate separately and take the stricter; do not conflate.
map.耐光用蓝色羊毛标样 1–8 级（8 最优）对照，与变色灰卡 1–5 级体系不同；: Light uses blue wool standards 1-8 (8 best), different from the 1-5 gray scale; assess sun fading per GB/T 8427 separately, not by the gray scale directly.
